// Module
var code = `<h1>Variable update method</h1> <p>Choose how variables are updated so the story model can focus on writing the story.</p> <h2>Alongside AI output</h2> <p>World-book entries are sent to the AI through SillyTavern's normal flow. The AI includes variable-update analysis and commands in its reply, and MVU applies those updates.</p> <h2>Extra-model parsing</h2> <p>This method splits the request: one AI writes the story, then another AI analyzes that story and updates the variables.</p> <p>To separate the two tasks, MVU filters world-book entries before sending them through SillyTavern's normal flow:</p> <ul> <li>Entries whose names contain <code>[mvu_plot]</code> are sent only to the story AI.</li> <li>Entries whose names contain <code>[mvu_update]</code> are sent only to the variable-update AI.</li> <li>Entries containing neither <code>[mvu_plot]</code> nor <code>[mvu_update]</code> are sent to both AIs.</li> </ul> <p>An MVU character card therefore needs <code>[mvu_plot]</code> or <code>[mvu_update]</code> in its world-book entry names to support extra-model parsing.</p> <p>Cards made with the latest <a href="https://stagedog.github.io/%E7%BB%9C%E7%BB%9C/%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B/%E6%89%8B%E5%86%99mvu%E5%8F%98%E9%87%8F%E5%8D%A1/">MVU tutorial</a> support extra-model parsing directly. You can also use that tutorial to adapt older cards.</p> <h3>Manual retry and incremental repair</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Retry extra-model parsing</strong> discards this floor's existing variable result and fully parses the floor again from the preceding state.</li> <li><strong>Incrementally repair extra-model parsing</strong> first opens an optional direction prompt; leaving it empty runs the automatic audit. It preserves changes that were already applied correctly and asks the extra model only for absolute corrections to missing or incorrect values. MVU previews the patch before applying it, writes confirmed corrections back into this floor's <code>&#x3C;UpdateVariable></code> block, and offers click-to-undo from the success notification.</li> </ul> <p>If the chat, floor, swipe, message text, or variables change while an incremental repair is pending, MVU discards that result instead of overwriting newer progress.</p> `;
// Exports
export default code;
